MIGRATION: AddAnalyticsIndexesAndDigestMarker.cs — reviewed SQL: CreateTable weekly_digest_markers (id uuid PK, fleet_id uuid FK, iso_year int, iso_week int, sent_at timestamptz), 7 CreateIndex ops (analytics composite), 1 unique CreateIndex for the marker (fleet_id, iso_year, iso_week). No destructive ops (no drops/renames of existing columns/tables). Down() cleanly drops all created artifacts.

8. TDD cycle: RED — test failed with CS1061/CS0246 because WeeklyDigestMarker did not exist. GREEN — entity+config+DbSet+indexes+migration added; test passed (1/1). REFACTOR — full suite: 494 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing perf test), 0 failed.

9. DIGEST JOB WRITE PATTERN: Test uses null-tenant scope (CurrentTenant.FleetId not set) and sets FleetId explicitly on the entity — same pattern as OfferTimeoutJob and StalePositionJob. GuardTenantEntities() passes when currentTenant.FleetId is null. Matches the design: weekly digest job writes via IgnoreQueryFilters with explicit FleetId.

10. FK SEEDING: Test seeds a Fleet row before inserting WeeklyDigestMarker rows, so the FK to fleets is satisfied. Without this, the first insert would violate 23503 (FK violation) instead of the expected 23505 (unique constraint), giving a false test failure.
